item.title: Progress Kemp LoadMaster Flaw Hits CISA KEV After 792 Reported Exploit Attempts
item.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a critical-severity security flaw impacting Progress Kemp LoadMaster to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation in the wild.
